shortcutTakenFallback: {taken} is already used by another app, so Rumor will use {used}. You'll be able to change it in Settings.
shortcutTakenNone: {taken} is already used by another app. You'll be able to pick another shortcut in Settings.
welcome: Rumor is in the tray. Click to play, right-click for options.
hintStartColor: The one playing when Rumor opens.
hintFade: How long the noise takes to come in and go out when you play or pause.
hintMaxVolume: The volume control's 100 % maps to this level. Handy with headphones.
hintOutputChange: What to do if the sound would move to another output, such as speakers.
hintOnLaunch: Whether it should start playing by itself.
hintPresets: The panel's three buttons, in minutes.
hintEndFade: When the timer ends, the noise fades out slowly.
shortcutsIntro: Click a shortcut and press the keys. Esc cancels; Delete clears it.
errTypesCharacter: On your keyboard it types a character with AltGr. Pick another.
hintLeftClick: Right click always opens the panel.
hintTheme: Light, dark or the one Windows uses.
hintAccent: The playing noise's colour or Windows' accent colour.
hintMica: The background lets a little of the desktop through (Windows 11).
hintSpectrum: The sound's curve in the panel.
hintLaunchAtLogin: Rumor appears in the tray when the computer starts.
hintDevice: If you pick a fixed one and it disconnects, Rumor pauses; it never switches output on its own.
hintBuffer: Bigger holds up better when the PC is busy; smaller responds sooner. The noise sounds the same.
hintBackup: Save your settings to a file or load them from one.
hintReset: Back to factory values. Your colour, volume and timer are kept.
aboutTagline: Pink, brown and white noise, generated in real time.
aboutTelemetry: No telemetry: Rumor sends nothing of yours. It only asks GitHub whether there's a new version.
aboutBugs: To report a bug, open an issue on GitHub and attach the log (Advanced → Logs).
hintPerOutputVolume: Remembers one volume for headphones, another for speakers… and applies it when you switch.
hintMono: The same sound on both sides, for listening with one earbud.
hintOnLock: With Win+L. On unlock it only plays again if you're still on headphones.
policyPauseResume: Pause, and resume when they're back
hintAlerts: When the timer ends, when the Pomodoro changes phase and for the ear break.
hintEarBreak: Reminds you to rest after hours on headphones. It never stops the noise.
hintStudyMode: A stopwatch to count your study time, with a Pomodoro if you want one. Off, Rumor is just noise.
hintPomodoro: In minutes, and how many work blocks come before the long break.
hintBreakNoise: With the noise linked, always with a fade.
hintLink: Play and pause together: starting or pausing one does the same to the other.
hintIdle: If you don't touch the keyboard or mouse for that long, you'll be asked whether you were still studying.
hintTags: To file each session under a subject. If you create none, they don't appear.
tagErrDuplicate: There's already a tag with that name.
idleQuestion: You were inactive for {n} min. Were you still studying?
idleBody: You were inactive for {n} min. Answer in Rumor's panel.
earBreakBody: {n} h on headphones. A while without them will do them good.
hintCheckUpdates: Looks on GitHub now and then for a new version. Sends nothing of yours.
hintUpdateNow: Updating closes Rumor and reopens it in a few seconds; if it was playing, the noise carries on.
updateHint: Rumor {v} is ready. It closes and reopens in a few seconds.
updateFailed: Couldn't update. Try again, or download it from GitHub.
updateTitle: A new version of Rumor is out
updateBody: Rumor {v} is ready. Open the panel and press Update.
insightTagDown: *{tag}* has been going down for two weeks.
insightTagUp: *{tag}* has been going up for two weeks.
emptyFirstTitle: Your study hours will show up here
emptyFirstHint: Press play on the Study card in the panel to start your first session.
emptySessionsHint: Every session you finish shows up here, and you can correct it or add the ones you did without Rumor.
emptyWeekHint: Rest counts too. When you're back, your hours will show up here.
emptyJump: See the last week with study
errFuture: It can't end in the future.
errTooShort: It has to last at least 1 min.
errDuration: Write the duration as h:mm (1:25) or in minutes (85).
insightAboveAverage: You studied *{pct} % more* than your average of the previous {weeks} weeks.
insightBelowAverage: You studied {pct} % less than your average of the previous {weeks} weeks.
insightLongerSessions: Your sessions lasted *{mins} min longer* than usual.
insightShorterSessions: Your sessions were {mins} min shorter than usual.
insightMornings: You studied more *in the morning* than usual.
insightAfternoons: You studied more *in the afternoon* than usual.
insightEvenings: You studied more *in the evening* than usual.
errRunning: The session in progress can't change until it ends.
errUnavailable: The study history isn't available right now.
insightAboveAverageSoFar: You're *{pct} % ahead* of your average of the previous {weeks} weeks at this point.
insightBelowAverageSoFar: You're {pct} % behind your average of the previous {weeks} weeks at this point.
